annotations.text:
Measured from the real corpus, not invented:

30 subagents in one transcript, median 2 steps, max 41.
Durations 37s to 79 minutes, 99% of steps timed.
25 pairs genuinely overlap — nested boxes cannot show that,
which is the whole reason for lanes.

Only 50 of 142 subagents carry a description.
The lane label is therefore the kind, never the description,
and the card degrades to kind + steps + tools rather than
inventing a summary.
